name: jira-automation
description: Create, edit and diagnose Jira Cloud automation rules from supplied requirements, configuration and audit evidence. Draft triggers, conditions, branches, actions and smart values; review actor permissions and define audit-log tests. Diagnose service limits, retrieval caps, branch context and field-edit errors. Produce builder steps from pasted requirements, JSON exports, audit-log text or described screenshots.
